messages:
Mina Park: All-hands tomorrow 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET. Draft agenda: 1) Exec update + hiring highlight (Mina, 8m), 2) Billing policy: hybrid credits & overage options (Zoe, 10m), 3) Product callouts + launch checklist (Raj, 10m), 4) People Ops hiring plan + new leadership intro (Chloe, 5m), 5) Q&A (10m). Add Qs here or via form: https://forms.redwood/allhands-questions. Calendar invite: https://cal.redwood.com/e/def456. Recording on, captions enabled.
Zoe (Finance): We'll explain the hybrid billing pilot: moving certain free-tier workloads to a monthly credit pool and offering optional overage caps for smaller teams. Will share a one-pager.
Raj Patel: For product callouts I'll cover rollout windows for the region expansion and a checklist for traffic shaping and monitoring. Request SRE confirm canary windows.
Chloe (People Ops): Quick intro: welcoming two IC leads joining next week; I'll drop bios during my segment. Also note: hiring Q&A will be brief.
DevRel Bot: Reminder: slide deck uploads due EOD Tue to repo: https://repo.redwood/allhands-deck.
Sam: Can we get a short clarifying note on how hybrid credits affect billing alerts? Ops folks want to know thresholds.
Zoe (Finance): We'll show alert thresholds and new dashboard tiles. No retroactive billing changes.
--post meeting--
Mina Park: Recording uploaded: https://video.redwood/recs/2203456789. Transcript: https://video.redwood/recs/2203456789/transcript. TL;DR: exec update on product + hiring; finance announced hybrid credits pilot and optional overage caps; product shared region launch checklist and canary guidance; People Ops introduced new IC leads. Action items: Zoe to publish billing one-pager + FAQ (due Fri), Raj to post rollout checklist + SRE canary confirmation (due Wed), Chloe to share new hire bios and contact links (due Mon). I'll create Asana tasks and tag owners. Thanks all! :shipit:
